notes.title: Cleric and Goblins, Challenge for the 'VR Game of the Year'!
notes.content:
Dear everyone, it's that time of year again—the annual Steam festival! It's the season for the Steam Awards. We are proud to announce that our latest VR game, "Cleric and Goblins" aims to be nominated in the VR Game of the Year category!

"Cleric and Goblins" is a somewhat challenging VR game, but with its rewarding challenges and the charm of the adorable Kurelik, it has received acclaim from numerous players. It has been a hot topic on social media and online platforms. This is all thanks to your enthusiastic support!

To spread awareness of the game's charm even further, we aspire to be nominated in the VR Game of the Year category. The voting will be conducted by the Steam community. Each and every vote is crucial. Please support us, and let "Cleric and Goblins" shine as the VR Game of the Year!
